additional_info.subject: RE: ID0437011-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001094] HMI spinning during precharge CRM:00315002813
additional_info.body:
Hi,
First fault was a ecoG fault then?
Second fault is autocharge failure, Autocharge is active in SCB but the costumer has turned it off in their backend.
Due to some issues with their OCPP backend.
Can the issue with the HMI image spinning be if the session fails due to an ecoG error.
The communication “box” doesn’t indicate a fault so all 4 “boxes” just keeps spinning.
According to Kople the loading image doesn’t go away until they unplug the vehicle.
Maybe a bug in v7?
/Simen

additional_info.subject: ID0437011-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001094] HMI spinning during precharge CRM:00315002813
additional_info.body:
Hi,
I would need EcoG logs, but the SupportedAppProtocol is something from EV side. So it's EV's fault I assume.
I don't know about the spinning since I've never face this issue. So I assume that EcoG is waiting for the timeout and until it does it will keep the same, waiting for the request.
Let me know if I answered all the questions.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0437011-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001094] HMI spinning during precharge CRM:00315002813
additional_info.body:
Hi!
You say it is a EV fault, I see the MAC is showing it is a MEB car 00.7d.fa.02.31.54
Guess this can also be a case of MEB issue? After my conversations with the costumer, I think in some cases when the session fails due to ecoG faults (MEB issue or comm error with the car). The HMI can get stuck with the loading screen, however its hard to recreate it seems.
This issue has also been observed by Markus in Finland.
/Simen
